scope: Requested component pages and primary model documentation; source capability observations are distinct from Apple design decisions. No installation or account invocation was performed.

components.apple_mapping: Public execution explanation / Working section; safe summary text only.
components.guard: Automatically track real active state. Never render hidden reasoning or duplicate the activity list.

components.apple_mapping: Indicate actual waiting/streaming beside the current step.
components.guard: Stop on completion, pause or error; respect reduced motion; do not fake perpetual work.

components.apple_mapping: Sources actually used: library pack, reusable code system, cached documentation and project artifact.
components.guard: Only real authorized provenance. A saved external origin does not mean live web browsing.

components.apple_mapping: Relevant follow-ups after a response or initial ideas.
components.guard: Respect Studio gate; no automatic new paid run and no compulsory asset-choice preview.

components.documented_capability: Collapsible workflow task presentation with file references.
components.apple_mapping: Group meaningful world/gameplay/UI work and affected files.
components.guard: Status is derived from task/operation receipts; avoid a separate model call to narrate each node.

components.documented_capability: Tool invocation view with execution and approval/error states.
components.apple_mapping: Inspectable typed invocation/result with file/system links and safe error detail.
components.guard: Side-effect receipt governs success; redact payload secrets and paginate large results.

components.documented_capability: Composable chat input and submit controls.
components.apple_mapping: English composer, UI theme, attachments, send/steering controls.
components.guard: Hard disabled before pairing/connection/authorization; Stop is separately enabled during an authorized run.

components.apple_mapping: Public genre-specific feature/content plan, updated on steering.
components.guard: A plan card is not a Plan mode or mandatory approval button; explicit talk-only requests never mutate.

components.documented_capability: Chat message and markdown/action component suite.
components.apple_mapping: Canonical assistant/user messages, summaries and artifact sections.
components.guard: Use real persisted text once; do not introduce response-branching/retry that replays mutations blindly.

components.documented_capability: Inline references with expandable source information.
components.apple_mapping: Cite a source/file/system at the supported claim.
components.guard: Resolve IDs server-side to real project revision/source records; no invented path or line range.

components.apple_mapping: Persistent message/event history for one project/game.
components.guard: Respect manual scrolling; reconnect hydration must not duplicate events or lose artifacts.

components.apple_mapping: Compact per-run/model usage detail where telemetry exists.
components.guard: Do not show Codex developer quota as Apple use. Unknown counts/cost are unavailable, not zero or guessed.

components.documented_capability: Approval interface for consequential tool actions.
components.apple_mapping: Restore/overwrite or other actually-required explicit authorization.
components.guard: Not a per-asset gate. Denial is respected; do not restore removed product modes or auto-publish.

components.documented_capability: Conversation checkpoint marker with restore action.
components.apple_mapping: Link durable project restore points to the associated run/changes.
components.guard: A marker alone is not a backup; restore must use a real snapshot and safe authorized operation.

components.documented_capability: Collapsible labelled steps with status and media support.
components.apple_mapping: Public Activity timeline from observable execution stages.
components.guard: Use as UI vocabulary only, never private internal thought. Avoid a second duplicated Reasoning panel.

components.apple_mapping: User reference files/images and produced artifacts within the project.
components.guard: Validate scope/type/size and authorization; attachment support does not add arbitrary customer-project takeover.

components.apple_mapping: One Apple vX capability/operation identity card.
components.guard: Show public capabilities, not raw system prompts/secrets. Jev does not become a visible second author.

components.documented_capability: Highlighted code with optional line numbers and copy actions.
components.apple_mapping: Actual generated/modified project scripts, with identity/revision.
components.guard: Lazy/collapsed for beginners; ensure full correct content when opened, no fake files or executable credentials.

components.apple_mapping: Short real script/path/configuration references where useful.
components.guard: No invented commands or required manual coding workflow for beginners.

components.documented_capability: Renderer for AI SDK image data.
components.apple_mapping: Actual output/branding images; use a typed adapter for capture/artifact data where needed.
components.guard: This is not a generator. Label capture vs composed artwork and preserve provenance; never pass branding art as test evidence.

components.documented_capability: Streaming text presentation with a caret.
components.apple_mapping: Plain public status/message text while streaming.
components.guard: One canonical stream; coordinate with MessageResponse rather than duplicate or replay artificial typing.

components.apple_mapping: Real system readiness, results, source/resource tables and branding details.
components.guard: Replace demo rows and column assumptions; small/lazy tables, no new model-wall comparison.

components.apple_mapping: Actual project files and affected Studio hierarchy inside output detail.
components.guard: Not a permanent full IDE or backend corpus explorer; identifiers resolve to authorized real objects.

models.name: GLM 5.3 Flash
models.observed: Cloudflare documents @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash with function calling and vision. Existing-account availability was not tested.

models.name: Jev via Cloudflare
models.observed: Cloudflare lists typesafe/jev as third-party and documents state/questions with typed answers. Listing is not proof of deployment in Apple.

models.name: TypeSafe Jev model contract
models.observed: TypeSafe documents text-only input, model versioning and structured evaluation. Provider-specific limits may differ; use the deployed route contract.

aicss_registry_note: Both requested pages document install registries. Direct web fetches of registry JSON returned tool Internal Error, so registry availability/source entitlement was not verified. Use the legitimate accessible registry or already-licensed checked-in source; do not infer that every AICSS component is Pro-only, or claim installation complete.
